header.title: LGPD
header.subtitle: Brazil’s General Data Protection Law: Privacy for personal data.

facts.title: Who this affects
facts.value: Organisations processing personal data in Brazil
facts.description: Also those offering goods/services to people in Brazil or collecting data in Brazil—regardless of location.

items.title: Implement Security Measures
items.text: Adopt and maintain technical and organisational measures proportionate to your risks to protect personal data in daily operations (Art. 46).

items.title: Keep Records of Processing Operations
items.text: Maintain a formal register of processing operations—purpose, data categories, recipients, retention, and safeguards—available to the ANPD upon request (Art. 37).

items.title: Prepare Data Protection Impact Reports (RIPD)
items.text: Produce a RIPD for high-risk processing when required by the ANPD or per guidance (e.g., legitimate-interest scenarios), documenting risks and mitigations (Arts. 10 §3, 38).

items.title: Govern Operators (Processors)
items.text: Define controller instructions, use compliant contracts, and oversee operators and sub-operators to ensure adherence (Art. 39).

items.title: Appoint a DPO (Encarregado)
items.text: Designate a DPO (unless exempted by ANPD rules), provide a public contact channel, and handle rights requests within LGPD timelines (Art. 41; Art. 18).

items.title: Purpose Limitation & Necessity
items.text: Process only what is necessary for specific, legitimate purposes; embed minimisation into systems and workflows (Art. 6, items I & III).

offer.title: What we offer
offer.subtitle: Programmes are tailored end-to-end and may depend on earlier phases (e.g., deletion protocols require prior identification of personal-data flows and systems).

cards.title: External DPO (Encarregado)
cards.desc: We act as your DPO: advise management, monitor compliance, train staff, oversee RIPDs, liaise with the ANPD, and report risks with practical remediation paths.

cards.title: Brazil Market Entry & Client Readiness
cards.desc: Be contract-ready for Brazilian customers: lawful bases, privacy notices, transfer mechanisms, operator clauses, and evidence packs that pass procurement and due diligence.

cards.title: Records of Processing (Art. 37)
cards.desc: We establish your register of processing operations—what you process, why, with whom, where, retention, and safeguards—and set a lightweight routine to keep it current.

cards.title: RIPD — Company-Specific Impact Report
cards.desc: A thorough, personalised RIPD for high-risk processing: scope, stakeholder interviews, risk analysis tailored to your systems and business model, mitigation design, and sign-off documentation.

cards.title: Incident & Breach Readiness
cards.desc: Design and embed a 72-hour response playbook with roles, decision trees, and notification templates (ANPD and data subjects). We train teams and set up the evidence you’ll need if an incident occurs.

cards.title: Retention & Deletion Operating Model
cards.desc: Define lawful retention by data category, implement deletion routines in systems, and set up audit logs to prove execution.

cards.title: Operator (Processor) Oversight
cards.desc: Practical onboarding and periodic review of operators: requirement baselines, contractual clauses, transfer mechanisms, and an oversight cadence that fits your vendor landscape.

cards.title: LGPD for AI Systems
cards.desc: Align AI features and workflows with LGPD: controller/operator role mapping, legal bases, transparency to users, records updates, RIPD triggers, and acceptable-use guidance for teams.

items.v: The ANPD is issuing guidance, opening procedures, and can impose fines, public notices, and processing restrictions.
High-risk processing may require a RIPD and controls before go-live. Planning these steps avoids delays and non-compliance.
International transfers require valid mechanisms (adequacy, clauses, or seals). Clients increasingly ask for proof during due diligence.

steps.d: Focused discovery across product features, data flows, and vendors to baseline actual practice.
Co-create bespoke controls and workflows (minimisation, RIPD cadence, operator intake, breach playbooks) aligned to your reality.
Embed changes with your teams and produce evidence packs that stand up in audits and client reviews.
Quarterly tune-ups: records updates, transfer reassessments, spot checks, and change logs that prove control over time.

cta.title: Avoid fines. Protect trust. Keep your business running.
cta.body: We design LGPD controls that fit your organisation and generate evidence you can stand behind.
